blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has signed Administrative Order No. 50, transferring the management of Mile-Long Property back to the Privatization and Management Office (PMO) to facilitate its disposition and maximize its value. The PMO is an attached agency of the Department of Finance (DOF) that acts as the government’s marketing and disposition arm
